self_review: One adversarial pass challenged PDF engine vs reader, wrappers vs duplicates, stale pins (flags only), QA entry points, settings owner evidence, and NA rows for unsupported speech/media/Swift/agent features. It corrected cargo:rightkit-qa from N to Y because qa-e2e directly calls Control, Harness, and workspace; retained npm:@rightkit/qa N for active local raw-CDP browser harness; retained pdf-ui M because shared helpers/assets coexist with app-owned basic reader rendering/search.
